## User task and result

What task does this improve? Describe the current behavior and the resulting behavior.

## Scope and decision

Why this approach? Note a material tradeoff or an alternative if it affects review.

## Verification

List commands actually run and their results. For behavior fixes, explain the
regression covered. Include synthetic screenshots when they help; identify checks
that remain unrun and known limitations.

## Data, compatibility, and documentation

Describe changes to request execution, storage, supported environments, or public
API. Link updated docs where relevant. Leave this section out if none changed.

## Contribution and assistance

Describe relevant AI assistance and the review/verification performed. Omit private
inputs, credentials, employer/customer details, and unrelated personal context.
